note: Statistics that are neither declared script-written (data-owned-by on the card) nor documented in method.html. This list should shrink, never grow. Regenerate with --update only when removing entries, or when the RULE changes and the new backlog is recorded deliberately -- as on 2026-11-22, when it rose from 0 to 17. Until that day a data-field attribute counted as proof that an updater owned a value. It is not: of 68 headline values carrying one, the field name of only 11 appeared in any script, workflow or data file. The 17 here are the figures that were resting on the attribute and nothing else. They are NOT fixed by being listed: each needs a row in MASTER_DATA.md, a data-owned-by naming the script that writes it, or a data-frozen reason. 11 are DESE figures on education-statewide.html, 2 are national payroll levels on employment-dashboard.html, and the rest are single figures on mbta-3a, pension and tax-budget.
